name: Leah
tagline: Leah autonomously runs contracting, legal, and procurement work across the enterprise.
description: Leah is an enterprise agentic AI company. Built on a decade of contracting, legal, and procurement expertise, it autonomously runs work across the enterprise, from the contract lifecycle and legal requests to source-to-pay. Founded in London in 2015 and backed by SoftBank and Insight Partners, Leah serves 400+ global enterprises and supports mission-critical processes in regulated industries. Leah works with partners including Microsoft, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, PwC and KPMG to support enterprise transformation programs globally.
